mathematical_checks.statement: For fixed opponents, c_x^{-i} is fixed; if i uses target x, target load is m−c_x^{-i}. Therefore C_i(A_i,s_{−i})=K_i(s̄_{−i})−u_i(X∖A_i,s̄_{−i}), with K_i=Σ_x v_x/(b_x+1+c_x^{-i}).
mathematical_checks.reason: The denominator is b_x+m+1−(m−c_x^{-i})=b_x+1+c_x^{-i}. K_i depends on opponents but not i’s chosen action. δ_i^C=−δ_i^u follows by subtraction at the identical opponent profile. Weak PNE, ties and empty actions are preserved; duplicate labels are harmless for these static quantities.

mathematical_checks.statement: If source coverage is c_x and target load k_x=m−c_x, Ψ=Σ_x v_x H_{b_x}(m)−Φ, where Φ=Σ_x v_x H_{b_x}(c_x).
mathematical_checks.reason: Reindexing j=1,…,m−c_x in Σ_j v_x/(b_x+m+1−j) gives the harmonic tail from c_x+1 through m. The constant is independent of every full profile. No condition at p_x(0) is used.

The complement identities establish equality, not nonnegativity. At source same-action PNE, PNE alone gives δ_i^u≤0. The independent quantitative Shapley comparison is needed to give Φ(t̄)−Φ(s̄)≤Σ_iδ_i^u. The bridge-only edge correctly records contribution and remaining instead of whole_result.

At fixed Bernoulli p, the empty sample contributes zero difference; singleton {i} gives C_p({T_i})−K_p; samples with at least two slots are bounded by Σ_i d_{T_i,p} using monotonicity after adjoining B and diminishing marginal returns above B. Division by p and integration produce exactly the actual Shapley unilateral payoff differences. PNE controls these integrals, without requiring pointwise best-response inequalities in p. The upstream same-identity deletion formula agrees under t=1−p.

mathematical_checks.statement: Coverage specialization permits each fixed real b_x≥0, not only an integer number of background players.
mathematical_checks.reason: For each p∈(0,1), C_p(U)=Σ_{x∈∪U}v_x(1−p)^{b_x} is normalized, monotone and submodular. A customer covered j≥1 times gives marginal integral v_x∫_0^1(1−p)^{b_x+j−1}dp=v_x/(b_x+j). Its potential integral expands by a finite geometric sum into v_x H_{b_x}(j); the j=0 term is zero.

mathematical_checks.statement: All nodes j=1,…,m can be matched by nonnegative-coefficient polynomial fees of common degree O(m²); rational inputs have polynomial construction time and bit length.
mathematical_checks.reason: For m≥2, D+1=9m(m+1) and A=b_x+m+1≥M=m+1. The coefficient perturbation decreases with A and is bounded by mM36^{m−1}(m/M)^{9mM}. Using (m/M)^M<1/2, mM≤2^{2m}, and 36<2^6 bounds it by 2^{−m−6}<1. Hence every changed coefficient remains positive; higher truncated coefficients are unchanged positive. Rescaling y=z/A preserves positivity. m=1 uses a constant. Polynomially many rational powers/products have polynomial total bit length.

mathematical_checks.statement: ALL {S,B} implies, for every target full profile t, Ψ(t)−Ψ(s)≥Σ_i[C_i(t_i,s_{−i})−C_i(s)]≥0.
mathematical_checks.reason: S supplies Φ(t̄)−Φ(s̄)≤Σ_iδ_i^u≤0; B maps both potential and unilateral differences with opposite sign. Negating the inequality yields the complete target. This is global minimization of Rosenthal potential over all legal complete profiles, conditional on the listed model assumptions and the existence of the specified same-action exact PNE; it is not a theorem that every PNE is same-action or globally minimal.

mathematical_checks.statement: The target’s direct proof extends the same-action static conclusion to arbitrary nondecreasing unit-weight resource costs.
mathematical_checks.reason: At common action B, removing r_x users from x∈B loses at most r_x p_x(m) potential, while adding r_x users to x∉B gains at least r_x p_x(1). These signed bounds sum exactly to the fixed-start unilateral cost difference sum, including cancellations for retained resources. This is a separate proof and does not erase the two named premises of the declared transfer edge.

mathematical_checks.statement: The complement map does not preserve the same complete pure SPE in the 13-client example.
mathematical_checks.reason: All three follower replies (C,B,B) are optimal after their respective roots. The source root strictly prefers A; its complement root strictly prefers B or C over A. The root deviation changes the actual follower action, hence changes K_i and prevents cancellation. The counterexample does not refute the static PNE or potential transfer, does not imply absence of other target SPE, and has an actual terminal profile (A,C) that is not the required same-action static PNE.
